concept.title: Data Visualization
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the Vibration X-axis FFT Absolute Value graph.

conbody.p: This section describes the Vibration X-axis FFT Absolute Value graph.
You can hover on a section of the Vibration X FFT absolute value graph to view the Vibration X FFT absolute value in metre per second squared (m/s2), the frequency in Hertz (Hz), and the time frame.
